message.content: {"basis": "The dashboard is titled 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'. The pie-slice labels give the global consumption shares: Fossil Fuels (50%), Renewables (25%), Nuclear (15%), Hydroelectric (10%). Comparing these, Fossil Fuels (50%) is the largest category, exceeding Renewables (25%), Nuclear (15%), and Hydroelectric (10%). The routing criterion is the largest global energy consumption category, so the matching route option is 'Route Fossil Fuels to priority source monitoring'.", "option_label": "Route Fossil Fuels to priority source monitoring"}
